newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: INSTANT VIEW-Drop in spreads Portuguese bonds/Bund.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW-Drop in spreads Portuguese bonds/Bund.

text.p: The following is a series of immediate reactions to the drop in the spread between Portuguese 10-year bonds and Bunds to 110 basis points (bp) after news that European Union heads of government had agreed on a stability pact for countries joining a planned single currency in 1999.

"In the short term -- next week -- I think the spread (10-year Portuguese bonds against Bunds) could stand in a range between 100 and 110 basis points (bp). I think the spread between Portuguese and Spanish 10-year bonds could stand at between zero and 10 basis points (bp).
CARLOS PINTO FERREIRA, BANCO PORTUGUES DO ATLANTICO
"The stability pact means more financial discipline for those trying to meet the criteria. It is good news for Portugal as it could help make our progress to join the euro sustainable."
"It was important to reach this stability pact because there had been fears over how countries with different policy traditions in terms of financial and exchange rate stability could converge."
